tei:div.tei:p: rigs sngags rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon po// sa gsum marungs gcig char gsod byed pa// 'chol ba'i khro bo rdo rje gro bo lod// 'di rtsam ma yin skye ba'i phreng bar skyong*// 'dir bla ma drag po rta khyung 'bar ba'i sgo nas/ bka' bsgo byed pa la/ dang po/ na moḥ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kunaḥ mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma dang ཿ rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor laḥ snying nas dad pas skyabs su mchiḥ skyabs 'gro dang*/ hoḥ rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nasaḥ pha ma 'gro drug sems can kunaḥ tshad med snying rjes sgrol ba'i phyiraḥ smon 'jug don dam byang sems bskyedaḥ sems bskyed nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul gyis bla ma drag por gsal la bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūṃḥ snod bcud sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ glags lta bar gcod bdud kyi rigasaḥ gtor ma longs la gzhan du dengasaḥ bka' las 'da' na rdo rjes gzhomaḥ bden stobs brjod pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ lha las khyad par du gyur pa 'chol ba'i khro bo bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed rdo rje gro bo lod kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi tshe srog stobs 'byor la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs gang su yang rung ba'i 'byung po thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba 'di bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gem par 'gyur ta re/ zhes hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūṃ/ gi sprul pa spro/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā guru artsig nirtsig hrīḥhūṃ khroṃḥphaṭaḥ

rtsa sngags dang hūṃ bzhis bgegs bskrad nas thun brdeg de nas/ hūṃḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams laḥ bgegs dang bar gcod ming yang medaḥ glo bur rnam rtog 'khrul ba'i gdonaḥ chos dbyings ngang du mtshams bcad doḥ kyis srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ kun bzang don phrin las mtshams kyi rgyal po mi rtog ye shes la/ bgegs kyi rgyal po rnam rtog mtshams chod cig ces pa'i don/ bsgrub bya'i sgo gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab pas bsrung ba ni/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyis bdag nyid las de'i gdangs rang rtsal rten 'byung 'gags pa med pa/ snying rje chen po zung du 'jug pa las nam mkhas gar khyab kyi phyi nang snod bcud kyi chos thams cad snang ba ma yin pa yang dag ye shes kyi snang ba 'og min pad+ma drwa ba dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang 'jigs su rung ba can tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i pho brang chen po'i dbus nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtsa bar gyur pa lugs 'byung srid pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi gdon gzugs dug sbrul bcu gnyis bsnol mar brdzis pa'i steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kyi yi ge hriḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po 'jigs byed rdo rje gro bo lod sku mdog dmar nag dus mtha'i zhugs kyi phung po ltar dmar zhing 'bar ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba'i myu gus ma mchu mnan pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur g.yo ba/ dbu skra smug 'bol tshom bur 'khyil ba/ rdo rje dung lung gis brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs su bsgrad pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rjogs pa'i phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la gsor zhing lcags sdig gi tshwa tshwa ser chen bzhin du 'bebs pa/

g.yon pas pad+ma dbang gi me khyung dmar po bsnams pas ye shes rigs lnga'i khyung gis steng 'og bar mtshams thams cad 'gengs zhing me stag gi zi ra khol bas dbu gtsug na phrin las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i rta mgo ljang gu phun phun ser po rngog ma le brgan zhur dkar po can dbang gi rta skad thengs gsum gsum 'tsher ba/ khyung gdangs rngams pas traṃ 'u traṃ drang srong gi dmod pa drag po 'brug ltar ldir ba steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad dpa' skong zhing dbang du bsdu ba de lta bu'i gnas gsum du/ sku rdo rje 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ gsung rdo rje pad+ma dbang chen/ thugs rdo rje he ru ka dpal yang dag gi dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams dang khyad par rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od dbang drag rol pa'i zhing khams nas 'jigs byed rdo rje khro bo'i sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐ḥ sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung bla ma drag po'iskuḥ dgod gshe drag shul rta mchog rol pa'i gsung ཿ snying rje rngam zhi ye shes khyung gi thugasaḥ log 'dren 'dul ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ kyis bstod/ de nas sku gsung thugs rten gang yang rung ba zhig bsgrub bya'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī sengha/ ye shes mdo/ bī ma la/ o rgyan gyi rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ lo chen bai ro tsa na/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ klong chen nam mkha'irnal 'byor sogs rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa dang*/

khyad par dpal chen po 'jigs byed rdo rje gro bo lod 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung*/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bden pa chen pos/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dbang bskur du gsol/ rtogs pa bskyed du gsol/ phyi bdud 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa/ nang bdud 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi bar gcod/ gsang ba gzung 'dzin 'khrul snang gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig mdor na bdud dang bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ skyabs par mdzad du gsol/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā gu ru artsika nirtsika hrīḥhūṃ khroṃḥphaṭaḥ rtsa sngags gsham/ ka ya sid+dhi ā+oṃḥ wak+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ bden pa'i dmod btsugs nas byin rlabs/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ces phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ bla ma drag po 'od du zhu ba khyed rang rnams la thim pas khyed rang rnams skad cig gi 'jigs byed gro bo lod du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par a/ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng gi 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus rdo rje'i go khrab kyis g.yogs shing ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad du ye shes kyi khyung gi tshwa tshwas gtams shing 'thab pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs par mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsika nirtsika hrīḥhūṃ khroṃḥphaṭaḥ rtsa sngags gsham/ ka wa tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sbyar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin brlabs dang*// yi dam dbang drag pad+ma'i byin rlabs kyis// bsrung bya 'di la bdag gis bsrung zin gyis// phyin chad sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /srungs shig skyobs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā/ nad rims rkyen bgegs bar chad zhi ba dang*/ sogs brjod/ mi dgos kha la btags kyang*// dgos rgyu rgyun chad med pa'i// sprul sku 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab// rab kha'i rta snyo'i skyen du// chos smra tshul khrims rgya mtshos// sprang po'i khug li bzhin du// dran dran sna tshogs bsdus pas// dgos dgos lag cha byed nas// dkor sdus phya g.yang khug cig// /
